change: Read-only instrument/effect detail windows and owned plugin metadata
notes: Preview windows and other build/test processes were stopped during this run. Audio processing and the benchmark sources are unchanged; Cargo reused the existing benchmark binary.

Criterion reports historical changes of +4.74% baseline and +3.21% telemetry, both above its noise threshold. These are slower measurements, not evidence of an improvement; no causal attribution to detail-window code is possible from this benchmark, which does not link the viewer.
Four channels; playback restarts every 180 blocks. Telemetry queues are consumed every 12 blocks, approximately 30 Hz.

This microbenchmark excludes GPUI layout, painting, open detail windows and device I/O. UI responsiveness, concurrent-window audio load and physical-device callback p95/p99/xrun endurance are not measured here.

Real GPUI dark/light captures, keyboard scrolling, close/reopen and accepted watch updates are covered separately by the detail-window smoke. Physical mouse/trackpad, fullscreen and system appearance-switch acceptance still require an unlocked desktop.
